title: Pixel Dash
shortDescription: An endless runner with two inputs and no brakes. Jump the blocks and the gaps, duck under the saw blades, and see how far you get before it outruns your reflexes.
howToPlay: Space or a tap jumps; hold ↓ (or hold a finger on the lower third of the screen) to duck. Blocks and gaps you jump, saw blades you duck under — a blade sits too low to jump and too high to run through.

title: Stack Tower Rush
shortDescription: Tap at exactly the right moment to drop each block dead centre. Perfect stacks stay wide, sloppy ones shave your tower down to a toothpick.
howToPlay: One input: Space or a tap drops the sliding block. Anything hanging over the edge is sliced off and the next block is that much narrower, so land them centred. A perfect drop is forgiven entirely and widens your margin back.

title: Drift Alley
shortDescription: Hold one key to drift, release to grip. Slide through an apex to grow your chain, arrive straight and lose it, and clip a wall to end the run.
howToPlay: ←→ steers, Space holds a drift; on a phone, hold anywhere and slide left or right. Sliding through a corner builds your chain — arrive straight and you lose it, clip a wall and the run is over.

title: Neon Snake
shortDescription: The classic snake loop with a glow-up: speed ramps every ten pellets, and the lit gap in the middle of each wall wraps you across — everything else is solid.
howToPlay: Arrows, WASD or a swipe turns. Speed steps up every ten pellets. Only the lit gap in the middle of each wall wraps you through to the other side — the rest of the wall, and your own tail, ends the run.

title: Hoop Streak
shortDescription: Drag, release, sink the shot, keep the streak alive. You get sixty seconds, and the hoop starts sliding at ten baskets — then stops being polite at twenty-five.
howToPlay: Drag away from the ball and let go — the direction sets the arc, the distance sets the power. Or use ←→ for angle, ↑↓ for power, Space to shoot. Sixty seconds; nothing but net pays a bonus and every make in a row is worth more than the last.

title: Bubble Blaster Arena
shortDescription: Aim, ricochet, clear the board. Pop a cluster and everything it was holding up falls with it — and a fresh row drops from the ceiling every eight shots.
howToPlay: Drag to aim and release to fire, or ←→ and Space. The dotted guide banks off the side walls exactly as the shot will. Three of a colour clears them; anything left with nothing above it drops, and dropped bubbles pay more than popped ones.

title: Tank Duel Arena
shortDescription: One tank against one bot in a box full of walls that bounce your shells straight back at you. First to five hits takes the duel — then the bot gets better.
howToPlay: ←→ turns, ↑↓ drives, Space fires. On a phone, hold to drive towards your finger and release to shoot. The barrel points wherever the hull points — for the bot too, so if its barrel swings your way, move.

title: Slope Runner X
shortDescription: Steer a rolling ball down an infinite neon slope. Two keys, no brakes, a road that keeps narrowing, and corners that push you towards the drop.

title: Cookie Empire Tycoon
shortDescription: Click one cookie, end up running an orbital bakery. Eight producers, six upgrades, a golden cookie that pays seven times a tap while it lasts, and a franchise reset that makes the next run quicker.

title: Idle Mine Shaft
shortDescription: Dig, hire, automate. Deeper rock pays better, every 250 metres strikes a seam worth half a minute of income, and the haul crew keeps sinking the shaft while the tab is closed.

title: Click Kingdom
shortDescription: Tap to swing your sword, then hire a retinue to swing for you. Every foe you fell pays a bounty scaled to your income and makes the whole kingdom earn a little more.

title: Capybara Coin Farm
shortDescription: The most relaxed clicker on the site. Coins drop, capybaras doze, and petting them holds up a contentment meter that multiplies everything you earn — walk away and it just drifts back to normal.

title: Idle Space Colony
shortDescription: Terraform a dead rock one building at a time. The whole colony runs off a single power grid — let it drain into a brownout and your output more than halves, so keep working shifts to hold the domes lit, then jump system and start again richer.

title: Burger Baron Idle
shortDescription: Flip one patty by hand, then buy the grill that flips a hundred. Tickets pile up on the counter whether you are watching or not — a full counter quietly pays more per second, but clearing one by hand is worth four flips.

title: Crystal Tap Tycoon
shortDescription: Shatter crystals for shards, spend shards on drills, and chain taps inside a 1.2 second window to stack a combo worth up to eight and a half times a tap. Cheap upgrades and a low prestige bar make this the short-session one.
